title: Engagement PascalCase
summary:
Engagements use PascalCase everywhere: command text, option/possible labels, filtering, inline completion, and display.

- normalizeEngagementCommandText: strip separators, split camelCase word boundaries, PascalCase join (SetHeight preserved).
- Engagement: controlled/uncontrolled draft, PascalCase on options and possibles display.
- shouldRouteKeysToWindowEngagement: skip routing when engagement input is focused.
- CAD buildInteractionReplEngagement + replNormalizeCommandText (engagement mode) use shared normalizer.

Tests: @semio-tech/ui-react 90, @semio-tech/cad-js-renderer 66 passed.
